function @drawBattery($screen:screen, $charge:number, $X:number, $Y:number, $W:number, $H:number, $text:text)
	var $orange = color(245, 141, 66, 128)
	var $red = color(128, 64, 128, 200)
	$screen.draw_rect($X-3,$Y+6,$X+0.1,$Y+$H-6,white,gray) ; nub
	$screen.draw_rect($X,$Y,$X+$W,$Y+$H,white,black) ; main battery body
	if $charge > 0 && $charge < 0.06 ;smallest visible blue section if almost depleted
		$charge = 0.07
	if $charge > 0.06
		var $chargeW = $W * $charge
		if $text == "HV Battery"
			$screen.draw_rect($X+2,$Y+2,$X+$chargeW-2,$Y+$H-2,0,$orange) ; draw charge
		if $text == "LV Battery"
			$screen.draw_rect($X+2,$Y+2,$X+$chargeW-2,$Y+$H-2,0,$red) ; draw charge
	else
		$screen.draw_rect($X+1,$Y+1,$X+$W-1,$Y+$H-1,0,red) ; battery empty, draw red
	if size($text) > 0
		$screen.write($X+5,$Y+(($H-$screen.char_h)/2),white,$text)

var $invertX = 1  ; 0 for false, 1 for true
var $invertY = 0  ; 0 for false, 1 for true
; Function to convert degrees to radians
function @degToRad($degrees:number) : number
	return $degrees * pi / 180

; Function to linearly interpolate between two values
function @lerp($start:number, $end:number, $t:number,$power:number) : number
	return $start + ($end - $start) * ($t^$power)

; Function to calculate dynamic FOV based on screen dimensions
function @calculateFOV($screen_width:number, $screen_height:number) : number
	var $baseFOV = 30  ; Base FOV for reference screen size
	var $baseWidth = 100  ; Reference screen width
	var $baseHeight = 80  ; Reference screen height

	var $aspectRatio = $screen_width / $screen_height
	var $baseAspectRatio = $baseWidth / $baseHeight

	return $baseFOV * ($aspectRatio / $baseAspectRatio)

; Function to apply perspective projection to a 3D vector
function @perspectiveProjection($x:number, $y:number, $z:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number) : text
	var $fovRad = @degToRad($fov / 2)
	var $f = 1 / tan($fovRad)
	var $rangeInv = 1 / ($near - $far)

	var $px = $x * $f / $aspect
	var $py = $y * $f
	var $pz = $z * ($far + $near) * $rangeInv + (2 * $far * $near) * $rangeInv
	var $pw = -$z

	if $pw == 0
		$pw = 1

	var $_returnKVP = ""
	$_returnKVP.PX = $px / $pw
	$_returnKVP.PY = $py / $pw
	$_returnKVP.PZ = $pz / $pw
	return $_returnKVP

; Function to map normalized device coordinates (NDC) to screen coordinates
function @ndcToScreen($px:number, $py:number, $screen_width:number, $screen_height:number) : text
	var $_returnKVP = ""
	$_returnKVP.SX = ($px + 1) * $screen_width / 2
	$_returnKVP.SY = ($py + 1) * $screen_height / 2
	return $_returnKVP

; Function to draw a 3D vector on a 2D screen with smooth interpolation
function @drawVector($_screen:screen, $velocityX:number, $velocityY:number, $velocityZ:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number)
	var $projected = @perspectiveProjection($velocityX, $velocityY, $velocityZ, $fov, $aspect, $near, $far)
	var $px = $projected.PX:number
	var $py = $projected.PY:number

	; Apply inversion flags
	if $invertX == 1
		$px = -$px
	if $invertY == 1
		$py = -$py

	var $screen_width = $_screen.width
	var $screen_height = $_screen.height
	var $screenCoords = @ndcToScreen($px, $py, $screen_width, $screen_height)
	var $sx = $screenCoords.SX
	var $sy = $screenCoords.SY
	; Smooth interpolation
	var $steps = 50
	var $power = 1.1
	var $t = 0
	while $t <= 1
		var $interpX = @lerp($prevX, $sx, $t,$power)
		var $interpY = @lerp($prevY, $sy, $t,$power)
		; Draw a circle at the interpolated coordinates
		var $radius = (min($screen_width, $screen_height) / 2) * 0.07
		$_screen.draw_circle($interpX, $interpY, $radius, color(200, 200, 200, 8))
		; Draw the vertical line at the top of the circle
		var $lineTopX1 = $interpX
		var $lineTopY1 = $interpY - $radius
		var $lineTopX2 = $interpX
		var $lineTopY2 = $lineTopY1 - ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		$_screen.draw_line($lineTopX1, $lineTopY1, $lineTopX2, $lineTopY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))

		; Draw the horizontal line on the left side of the circle
		var $lineLeftX1 = $interpX - $radius
		var $lineLeftY1 = $interpY
		var $lineLeftX2 = $lineLeftX1 - ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		var $lineLeftY2 = $interpY
		$_screen.draw_line($lineLeftX1, $lineLeftY1, $lineLeftX2, $lineLeftY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))

		; Draw the horizontal line on the right side of the circle
		var $lineRightX1 = $interpX + $radius
		var $lineRightY1 = $interpY
		var $lineRightX2 = $lineRightX1 + ($radius * 1.2) ; Adjust length as needed
		var $lineRightY2 = $interpY
		$_screen.draw_line($lineRightX1, $lineRightY1, $lineRightX2, $lineRightY2, color(200, 200, 200, 255))
		$t = $t + (1 / $steps)
	; Update previous coordinates
	$prevX = $sx
	$prevY = $sy

; Function to update the velocity marker based on sensor readings
function @updateVelocityMarker($_screen:screen, $sensorVelocityX:number, $sensorVelocityY:number, $sensorVelocityZ:number, $fov:number, $aspect:number, $near:number, $far:number)
	var $velocityX = -$sensorVelocityX

function @navinDataToKVP()
	$navinKVP.FAS = input_number($navinAlias, 0)  ; 0 Forward Airspeed (m/s)
	$navinKVP.VS = input_number($navinAlias, 1)  ; 1 Vertical Speed (m/s)
	$navinKVP.ALT = input_number($navinAlias, 2)  ; 2 Altitude (meters from sea level)
	$navinKVP.AT = input_number($navinAlias, 3)  ; 3 Above terrain (meters)
	$navinKVP.HP = input_number($navinAlias, 4)  ; 4 Horizon Pitch (-1.0 to +1.0)
	$navinKVP.HR = input_number($navinAlias, 5)  ; 5 Horizon Roll (-1.0 to +1.0)
	$navinKVP.HDG = input_number($navinAlias, 6)  ; 6 Heading (0.0 to 360)
	$navinKVP.CRS = input_number($navinAlias, 7)  ; 7 Course (0.0 to 360)
	$navinKVP.LAT = input_number($navinAlias, 8)  ; 8 Latitude (degrees from -90 to +90)
	$navinKVP.LON = input_number($navinAlias, 9)  ; 9 Longitude (-180 to +180)

	;@latLonToXY($navinKVP.LAT, $navinKVP.LON)

function @dynamicLines($_screen:screen, $_navinKVP:text)
	var $pitch = $_navinKVP.HP * -90  ; Convert the normalized pitch to degrees
	var $roll = $_navinKVP.HR * -90  ; Convert the normalized roll to degrees
	var $centerX = $_screen.width / 2
	var $centerY = $_screen.height / 2
	var $radius = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.4
	var $yStep = $radius ; Step size for each 30 degrees of pitch

	; Draw the rotated centerline
	var $lineLength = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.5
	var $angleRad = $roll * pi / 90
	var $xOffset = $lineLength * cos($angleRad)
	var $yOffset = $lineLength * sin($angleRad)
	$_screen.draw_line($centerX - $xOffset+1, $centerY + $yOffset, $centerX + $xOffset, $centerY - $yOffset, color(0, 194, 0, 255))

	; Draw pitch ladder lines with rotation
	var $i = -18
	while $i <= 18
		var $lineY = $i * $yStep - $pitch * ($yStep / 5)
		if $lineY > -$radius*2 and $lineY < $radius*2
			var $ladderLength = (min($_screen.width, $_screen.height) / 2) * 0.17
			var $x1 = $centerX - $ladderLength * cos($angleRad) - $lineY * sin($angleRad)
			var $y1 = $centerY + $ladderLength * sin($angleRad) - $lineY * cos($angleRad)
			var $x2 = $centerX + $ladderLength * cos($angleRad) - $lineY * sin($angleRad)
			var $y2 = $centerY - $ladderLength * sin($angleRad) - $lineY * cos($angleRad)
			if $i == 0
				$_screen.draw_line($x1*0.95, $y1, $x2*1.05, $y2, color(255, 35, 0, 255))
			elseif abs($i) == 18
				$_screen.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, color(255, 0, 0, 255))
			else
				$_screen.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, color(0, 194, 0, 255))
		$i = $i + 1

	$_screen.write($xChunk * 0.62, $yChunk * 1, color(0, 194, 0, 255), "T-Alt " & (round($_navinKVP.AT)):text)

	;Left Hud Elements

	;Right Hud Elements

function @staticLines($_screen:screen)
	;Dividing the screen into chunks
	var $xChunk = $_screen.width / 10
	var $x = $xChunk * 8

	var $yChunk = $_screen.height / 10
	var $y = $yChunk * 8

function @drawH2Tank($screen:screen, $fill:number, $X:number, $Y:number, $W:number, $H:number, $text:text)
	var $lgreen = color(144, 232, 86, 128)
	var $dgreen = color(5, 40, 5, 255)
	var $atom_x = ($W/2)
	var $atom_y = $H
	
	;draw tank body
	$screen.draw_rect($X+(($W-$X)*0.25), $Y-2, $X+(($W-$X)*0.25)+3, $Y + $H+3, $dgreen,black)
	$screen.draw_rect($X+(($W-$X)*0.75), $Y-2, $X+(($W-$X)*0.75)+3, $Y + $H+3, $dgreen,black)
	$screen.draw_rect($X, $Y, $X + $W, $Y + $H, $dgreen,black) 					;tank body
	
	;draw fill	
	if $fill > 0 && $fill < 0.06 ;smallest visible section if almost depleted
		$fill = 0.07
	if $fill > 0.06
		var $fillW = $W * $fill
		$screen.draw_rect($X+2,$Y+2,$X+$fillW-2,$Y+$H-2,0,$lgreen) ; draw charge
	else
		$screen.draw_rect($X+1,$Y+1,$X+$W-1,$Y+$H-1,0,red) ; battery empty, draw red
	
	;draw atoms
	$screen.draw_circle($atom_x, $atom_y, 4, $dgreen, $dgreen)			;atom 1
	$screen.draw_circle($atom_x+10, $atom_y, 4, $dgreen, $dgreen)			;atom 2
	$screen.draw_line($atom_x, $atom_y, $atom_x+10, $atom_y, $dgreen)	;atom bond
	
	;write text
	if size($text) > 0
		$screen.write($X+(($Y-$X)*2)/1.5,$H-(($H-$screen.char_h)-25),$dgreen,$text)

	output_number("rengine2", 1, (-$engine_pitch))
	
	;AutoPilot
	;all off
	if $switch_AP_OnOff == 0
		output_number("db_autopilot", 2, 0)
	;set = off
	if $switch_levelflight == 0
		output_number("db_autopilot2", 1, 0)
	;Set current vertspeed and angle as inputs when AP is enabled
	if $switch_AP_OnOff and !$pulse_AP_last_up
		$pulse_AP!!
	$pulse_AP_last_up = $switch_AP_OnOff
	if $pulse_AP
		@pid1(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid2(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		$vertspeed = $speed_vert/10
		$hdgCtl = -$sensor_roll
		$pid_pitch = 0	
	;reset PID values to 0 when engaging level flight
	if $switch_levelflight and !$pulse_lvlFlight_last_up
		$pulse_lvlFlight!!
	$pulse_lvlFlight_last_up = $switch_levelflight
	if $pulse_lvlFlight
		@pid1(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid2(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		$vertspeed = 0
		$hdgCtl = 0		
	;reset PID values to 0 when engaging auto-pilot
	if $switch_Set_Mode and !$pulse_Set_Mode_last_up
		$pulse_Set_Mode!!
	$pulse_Set_Mode_last_up = $switch_Set_Mode
	if $pulse_Set_Mode
		@pid3(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid4(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		$altnew = $altitude
		$hdgNew = $heading
		$dest = $heading
		$setdest.clear()
	;Pitch and Altitude controls
	if $seat_up_down
		$pitchControl = $pitchControl/100
		$altnew = $altitude
		$vertspeed = 0
		@pid1(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid3(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if !$seat_up_down and $switch_AP_OnOff and !$switch_levelflight
		$pid_pitch = @pid1($vertspeed, $speed_vert/10, 0.25, 0.00015, 0.25))
		$pitchControl = clamp(($pid_pitch), -0.5, 0.5)
	if !$seat_up_down and $switch_levelflight and $switch_AP_OnOff
		;print($vertspeed,$hdgCtl)
		$pid_pitch = @pid1($vertspeed, $speed_vert/10, 0.25, 0.00015, 0.25)
		$pitchControl = clamp($pid_pitch, -0.5, 0.5)
	if !$seat_up_down and $switch_levelflight and $switch_Set_Mode and $switch_AP_OnOff
		$pid_alt = (@pid3(($altnew/100)+0.06, ($altitude/100), 20, 0, 6.9))
		$vertspeed = clamp(($pid_alt), -20, 10)/10
	if !$switch_levelflight and !$switch_AP_OnOff
		$pitchControl = 0
		$rollControl = 0
	;Roll and Heading Controls
	if $seat_q_e
		$rollControl = $rollControl/100
		$hdgNew = $heading
		$dest = $heading
		$hdgCtl = 0
		@pid2(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid4(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	if !$seat_up_down and $switch_AP_OnOff and !$switch_levelflight
		$pid_roll = @pid2($hdgCtl, -($sensor_roll),20,0.165,6.9)
		$rollControl = clamp($pid_roll, -1, 1)
		if abs($sensor_roll)<0.04
			$rollControl = $pid_roll*1.6
	if !$seat_q_e and $switch_levelflight; and $switch_AP_OnOff
		$pid_roll = @pid2($hdgCtl, -($sensor_roll),20,0.165,6.9)
		$rollControl = clamp($pid_roll, -1, 1)
		if abs($sensor_roll)<0.04
			$rollControl = $pid_roll*1.6
	if !$seat_q_e and $switch_levelflight and $switch_Set_Mode; and $switch_AP_OnOff
		$pid_hdg = @pid4($hdgNew, $heading, 0.025, 0.0001, 0.003)
		$hdgCtl = clamp(($pid_hdg), -0.3, 0.3)

	;pitch  
	if $button_pitchUp and !$pulse_pitchUp_last_up
		$pulse_pitchUp!!
	$pulse_pitchUp_last_up = $button_pitchUp
	if $pulse_pitchUp
		$trim_pitch += 0.0025
	if $button_pitchDown and !$pulse_pitchDown_last_up
		$pulse_pitchDown!!
	$pulse_pitchDown_last_up = $button_pitchDown
	if $pulse_pitchDown
		$trim_pitch -= 0.0025
	if $button_pitchReset and !$pulse_pitchReset_last_up
		$pulse_pitchReset!!
	$pulse_pitchReset_last_up = $button_pitchReset
	if $pulse_pitchReset
		$trim_pitch = 0	
	;yaw
	if $button_yawLeft and !$pulse_yawLeft_last_up
		$pulse_yawLeft!!
	$pulse_yawLeft_last_up = $button_yawLeft
	if $pulse_yawLeft
		$trim_yaw += 0.0025
	if $button_yawRight and !$pulse_yawRight_last_up
		$pulse_yawRight!!
	$pulse_yawRight_last_up = $button_yawRight
	if $pulse_yawRight
		$trim_yaw -= 0.0025
	if $button_yawReset and !$pulse_yawReset_last_up
		$pulse_yawReset!!
	$pulse_yawReset_last_up = $button_yawReset
	if $pulse_yawReset
		$trim_yaw = 0
	;Autopilot Reset
	if $button_AP_reset
		$trim_pitch = 0.078
		$trim_yaw = 0
		$altnew = $altitude
		$hdgNew = $heading
		$dest = $heading
		$setdest.clear()
		@pid1(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid2(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid3(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		@pid4(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
			
	;Keypad
	$sc_ap.blank(black)
	$sc_ap.write(41,6,green,"7")
	
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(39,4,48,15,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(39,4,48,15,green,green)
		$setdest.append("7")
	$sc_ap.write(51,6,green,"8")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(49,4,58,15,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(49,4,58,15,green,green)
		$setdest.append("8")
	$sc_ap.write(61,6,green,"9")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(59,4,68,15,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(59,4,68,15,green,green)
		$setdest.append("9")
	
	$sc_ap.write(41,18,green,"4")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(39,16,48,27,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(39,16,48,27,green,green)
		$setdest.append("4")
	$sc_ap.write(51,18,green,"5")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(49,16,58,27,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(49,16,58,27,green,green)
		$setdest.append("5")
	$sc_ap.write(61,18,green,"6")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(59,16,68,27,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(59,16,68,27,green,green)
		$setdest.append("6")
	
	$sc_ap.write(41,30,green,"1")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(39,28,48,39,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(39,28,48,39,green,green)
		$setdest.append("1")
	$sc_ap.write(51,30,green,"2")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(49,28,58,39,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(49,28,58,39,green,green)
		$setdest.append("2")
	$sc_ap.write(61,30,green,"3")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(59,28,68,39,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(59,28,68,39,green,green)
		$setdest.append("3")
	
	$sc_ap.write(41,42,yellow,"<")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(39,40,48,51,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(39,40,48,51,green,green)
		if $setdest.size >= 1
			$setdest.erase($setdest.size-1)	
	$sc_ap.write(51,42,green,"0")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(49,40,58,51,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(49,40,58,51,green,green)
		$setdest.append("0")	
	$sc_ap.write(61,42,red,"X")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(59,40,68,51,green,color(0,0,0,64))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(59,40,68,51,green,green)
		$setdest.clear()
		$dest1 = 0
		$dest2 = 0
		$dest3 = 0
		$dest4 = 0
		$dest5 = 0
	
	$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,green,black)
	$sc_ap.write(12,18,green,"SET")
	
	$sc_ap.write(12,30,green,"ALT")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(3,28,38,39,green)
		$setalt = 1
		$sethdg = 0
		$setdest.clear()
	
	$sc_ap.write(12,42,green,"HDG")
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(3,40,38,51,green)
		$sethdg = 1
		$setalt = 0
		$setdest.clear()
	
	if $setalt == 1
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,28,38,39,green,color(0,255,0,16))
	if $sethdg == 1
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,40,38,51,green,color(0,255,0,16))

	;Set Altitude
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(3,16,38,27,green) and ($setdest.size >= 3) and ($setalt == 1) and (($altnew > 1000) or ($altnew < 15000))
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,16,38,27,green,green)
		if $setdest.size == 3
			$dest = ($dest1*100)+($dest2*10)+$dest3
			if $dest < 1000
				$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,red,red)
				$dest = 0
			else
				$altnew = $dest
				$setdest.clear()
		if $setdest.size == 4
			$altnew = ($dest1*1000)+($dest2*100)+($dest3*10)+$dest4
			$setdest.clear()
		if $setdest.size == 5
			$dest = ($dest1*10000)+($dest2*1000)+($dest3*100)+($dest4*10)+$dest5
			if $dest >15000
				$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,red,red)
				$dest = 0
			else
				$altnew = $dest
				$setdest.clear()
	;Set Heading
	if $sc_ap.button_rect(3,16,38,27,green) and ($setdest.size >= 1) and ($sethdg == 1)
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,16,38,27,green,green)
		if $setdest.size == 1
			$dest = $dest1
			$setdest.clear()
		if $setdest.size == 2
			$dest = ($dest1*10)+$dest2
			$setdest.clear()
		if $setdest.size == 3
			$dest = ($dest1*100)+($dest2*10)+$dest3
			if $dest == 360
				$hdgnew = 0
				$setdest.clear()			
			elseif $dest > 360
				$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,red,red)
				$dest = 0			
			else
				$hdgnew = $dest
				$setdest.clear()

		var $diff  = $dest - $heading
		if $diff > 180
			$ndiff = $diff - 360
		elseif $diff < -180
			$ndiff = $diff + 360
		elseif (($diff > -180) and ($diff < 0))
			$ndiff = $diff
		elseif (($diff < 180) and ($diff > 0))
			$ndiff = $diff

		if (($ndiff > -180) and ($ndiff < 0) and ($heading < 180) and (($ndiff+$heading) > 0))
			$hdgnew = ($dest)%360
		if (($ndiff > -180) and ($ndiff < 0) and ($heading < 180) and (($ndiff+$heading) > -180) and (($ndiff+$heading) < 0))
			$hdgnew = -10
		if (($ndiff < 180) and ($ndiff > 0) and ($heading > 180))
			$hdgnew = 370
		if (($ndiff < 180) and ($ndiff > 0) and ($heading < 180))
			$hdgnew = ($dest)%360	
		if ($ndiff > 180)
			print ("Larger than 180")
		if ($ndiff < -180)
			print ("smaller than -180")

	;Heading wrap-around controls	
	if (($hdgnew == -10) and ($heading <= 360) and ($heading > 180))
		$hdgnew = ($dest)%360
	if (($hdgnew == 370) and ($heading >= 0) and ($heading < 180))
		$hdgnew = ($dest)%360

	;keypad continued		
	if ($setdest.size < 1) and ($sethdg == 1)
		$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,"_")
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,16,38,27,color(0,0,0,246),color(0,0,0,246))
	if ($setdest.size < 4) and ($setalt == 1)
		$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,"_")
		$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,16,38,27,color(0,0,0,246),color(0,0,0,246))
	foreach $setdest ($index,$ins)
		if $index == 0
			$dest1 = $ins
		elseif $index == 1
			$dest2 = $ins
		elseif $index == 2
			$dest3 = $ins
		elseif $index == 3
			$dest4 = $ins
		elseif $index == 4
			$dest5 = $ins
			
		if $setdest.size == 1
			$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,text("{}_",$dest1))
		if $setdest.size == 2
			$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,text("{}{}_",$dest1,$dest2))
		if $setdest.size == 3
			$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,text("{}{}{}_",$dest1,$dest2,$dest3))
		if $setdest.size == 4
			$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,text("{}{}{}{}_",$dest1,$dest2,$dest3,$dest4))
		if $setdest.size == 5
			$sc_ap.write(6,6,green,text("{}{}{}{}{}",$dest1,$dest2,$dest3,$dest4,$dest5))
		if ($sethdg == 1) and ($index >= 3)
			$index = 0
			$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,green,black)
			$sc_ap.write(13,6,green,"Err")
			break
		if ($setalt == 1) and ($index >= 5)
			$index = 0
			$sc_ap.draw_rect(3,4,38,15,green,black)
			$sc_ap.write(13,6,green,"Err")
			break
	
		
	;Flight Control
	output_number("Yaw", 0, ((-$seat_a_d + $trim_yaw)/2))
	
	output_number("Elevator_l", 0, -($seat_up_down + $trim_pitch + $pitchControl + $pitchadd))
	output_number("Elevator_r", 0, -($seat_up_down + $trim_pitch + $pitchControl + $pitchadd))
	output_number("ElevatorHinge_l", 0, (-($seat_up_down + $trim_pitch + $pitchControl + $pitchadd)) / 2.1)
	output_number("ElevatorHinge_r", 0, (-($seat_up_down + $trim_pitch + $pitchControl + $pitchadd)) / 2.1)
	
	output_number("RollHinge_l", 0, (($seat_q_e + $rollControl)/2.4))
	output_number("RollHinge_r", 0, (($seat_q_e + $rollControl)/2.4))
	output_number("leftwing", 0, (($seat_q_e + $rollControl)/1.3))
	output_number("rightwing", 0, (($seat_q_e + $rollControl)/1.3))
	
	;Screen outputs
	;Pitch Screen
	if ($trim_pitch >= 0) and ($trim_pitch < 0.1)
		$sc_pitch.write(1, 2, green, text("P: {}", ceil($trim_pitch * 90)))
	if $trim_pitch >= 0.1
		$sc_pitch.write(1, 2, green, text("P: {}", ceil($trim_pitch * 90)))
	if ($trim_pitch < 0) and ($trim_pitch > -0.1)
		$sc_pitch.write(1, 2, green, text("P:{}", floor($trim_pitch * 90)))
	if $trim_pitch <= -0.1
		$sc_pitch.write(1, 2, green, text("P:{}", floor($trim_pitch * 90)))
	;Yaw Screen
	if ($trim_yaw > 0) and ($trim_yaw < 0.1)
		$sc_yaw.write(1, 2, green, text("Y:{}", floor(-$trim_yaw * 90)))
	if ($trim_yaw >= 0.1)
		$sc_yaw.write(1, 2, green, text("Y:{}", floor(-$trim_yaw * 90)))
	if ($trim_yaw <= 0) and ($trim_yaw > -0.1)
		$sc_yaw.write(1, 2, green, text("Y: {}", ceil(-$trim_yaw * 90)))
	if $trim_yaw <= -0.1
		$sc_yaw.write(1, 2, green, text("Y: {}", ceil(-$trim_yaw * 90)))
	;Throttle level Screen	
	if ($engine_throttle >= -1) and ($engine_throttle < -0.82)
		$sc_throttle.write(12, 7, green, text("{}", ceil((($engine_throttle + 1.00) * 0.5) * 100)))
	if ($engine_throttle <= 0.98) and ($engine_throttle >= -0.82)
		$sc_throttle.write(10, 7, green, text("{}", ceil((($engine_throttle + 1.00) * 0.5) * 100)))
	if $engine_throttle >= 0.98
		$sc_throttle.write(6, 7, green, text("{}", ceil((($engine_throttle + 1.00) * 0.5) * 100)))
	;Target ALtitude
	$sc_AltTgt.write(1, 13, green, text("Tgt Alt: {}", round($altnew)))
	;Target Heading
	if $dest > 360	;Displayes hdgnew to not show latitude input for $dest
		$sc_HdgTgt.write(1, 13, green, text("Tgt Hdg: {}", round($hdgnew)))
	if $dest < 360	;Used because entering values that cross the 360/0 limit will show strange target heading
		$sc_HdgTgt.write(1, 13, green, text("Tgt Hdg: {}", round($dest)))
	
	;AP Off
	if ($switch_Set_Mode == 0) or ($switch_levelflight == 0) or ($switch_AP_OnOff == 0)
		$sc_AltTgt.blank(black)
		$sc_HdgTgt.blank(black)
		$sc_ap.blank(black)
	
	;"Pull-up" alert
	var $PullUp = $tmr_alert * ((($alt_sea < $minAlt) or ($alt_land < $minAlt)) and ($speed_fwdAir > 30) and ($speed_vert < -5) and (($pitch_horizon * 90) > 3))
	output_number("db_autopilot", 18, $PullUp)
	output_number("buzzer", 1, 300)
	output_number("buzzer", 0, $PullUp)


shutdown
	$sc_pitch.blank(black)
	$sc_yaw.blank(black)
	$sc_throttle.blank(black)
	$sc_AltTgt.blank(black)
	$sc_HdgTgt.blank(black)
	$sc_ap.blank(black)

function @drawFlapSlider($sc:screen,$x:number,$y:number,$click_y:number,$max:number) : number
	if $click_y < $sc.height-$sc.height+12
		$click_y = $sc.height-$sc.height+12
	if $click_y > $sc.height-12
		$click_y = $sc.height-12
	if ($x > $sc.width) or ($x <=10)
		$x = $sc.width+3
	if ($y > $sc.height) or ($y <=10)
		$y = $sc.height+3
	;clear internal rect
	$sc.draw_rect(($sc.width/2)-($x/2),$sc.height-$sc.height+11,($sc.width/2)+($x/2),$sc.height-11,black,black)
	;draw outlines
	$sc.draw_rect(($sc.width/2)-($x/2),($sc.height/2)-($y/2),($sc.width/2)+($x/2),($sc.height/2)+($y/2),green)
	$sc.draw_line(($sc.width/2)-($x/2),($sc.height-11),($sc.width/2)+($x/2),($sc.height-11),green)
	$sc.draw_line(($sc.width/2)-($x/2),$sc.height-$sc.height+10,($sc.width/2)+($x/2),$sc.height-$sc.height+10,green)
	$sc.write(($sc.width/2)-2,$sc.height-$sc.height+2,green,"0")
	$sc.write(($sc.width/2)-5,$sc.height-9,green,"50")
	;draw slider indicator
	$sc.draw_rect(($sc.width/2)-($x/2),$click_y-2,($sc.width/2)+($x/2),$click_y+2,color(0,255,0,32),color(0,255,0,32))
		
	var $output_value = (($click_y - ($sc.height-$sc.height+12)) * (50 - 0)) / (($sc.height-12) - ($sc.height-$sc.height+12)) + 0
	$output_value = $output_value/90
	return $output_value

function @drawFlapIndicator($sc:screen)
	;variables
	var $c_x = ($sc.width / 2)
	var $c_y = $sc.height-15
	var $R = ($sc.width / 2) +5
	var $needle_length = $R - 10  ; Length of the needle
	var $marker_length = 2

	; Draw markers
	var $r1 = $r;-5
	var $r2 = $r;-5
	var $r3 = $r-1;-6
	var $r4 = $r-2;-7
	var $r5 = $r-3;-8
	var $pi = 3.14159265
	var $maxangle = 50
	var $intervals = 10
	var $mkAngle = 0
	var $anglex = -100
	var $minangle = 0
	var $numx = 0
	while $numx < 11
		$mkangle = -140 + (50 / $maxangle) * $minangle
		var $angle_rad = $mkangle*($pi/180)
		var $my1 = ($c_y/2)-$r1*cos($angle_rad)
		var $mx1 = ($c_x/4)-$r1*sin($angle_rad)
		var $my2 = ($c_y/2)-$r2*cos($angle_rad)
		var $mx2 = ($c_x/4)-$r2*sin($angle_rad)
		var $my3 = ($c_y/2)-$r3*cos($angle_rad)
		var $mx3 = ($c_x/4)-$r3*sin($angle_rad)
		var $my4 = ($c_y/2)-$r4*cos($angle_rad)
		var $mx4 = ($c_x/4)-$r4*sin($angle_rad)
		var $my5 = ($c_y/2)-$r5*cos($angle_rad)
		var $mx5 = ($c_x/4)-$r5*sin($angle_rad)
		$minangle+=5
		$numx++
		
		$sc.draw_point($mx1, $my1, green)
		$sc.draw_point($mx2, $my3, green)
		$sc.draw_point($mx3, $my3, green)
		$sc.draw_point($mx4, $my4, green)
		$sc.draw_point($mx5, $my5, green)
	
	$sc.write($c_y/2+30, $c_x-11, green, "0")
	$sc.write($c_y/2+8, $c_x+40, green, "50")

	$sc.draw_line($sc.width/4,5,$sc.width/4,25,green)
	$sc.draw_line($sc.width/4-1,7,$sc.width/4-1,21,green)
	$sc.draw_line($sc.width/4+1,7,$sc.width/4+1,21,green)
	$sc.draw_line($sc.width/4-1,21,$sc.width/4-6,22,green)
	$sc.draw_line($sc.width/4+1,21,$sc.width/4+6,22,green)
